findings.finding: The guard policy contradicts the frozen arithmetic. The stated TwoProduct evaluates x=a*b before Split, while the guard order places splitter work before the primary product. It also calls any nonzero addend producing zero an underflow, which rejects valid exact cancellation admitted by the retained TwoSum/update arithmetic and can change signed-zero behavior.

Refuse zero results as underflow only for a multiplication with two nonzero operands; permit additive exact cancellation to signed zero while still refusing nonfinite or nonzero subnormal results. State the scratch norm predicate explicitly as ordered lambda_norm(p1) <= input.initial_radius.
